6 frames on disk but playback DEFERRED (2026-08-08). The frames translate inside their canvas — content spans the full 256px width, horizontal centre drifts 52px across the loop, three frames touch both edges — so the camera slid off its tile and re-entered from the left. The bank is also a 203-256px wide assembly against a 46px-wide still, which made the LPR read far larger than the player. The sweep is projected instead from the sim's own heading as a bounded mast swivel in EntityProjector. Restore a clip only if a scan bank arrives that holds position and width across frames.
Batch 6 wiring. 10-frame one-shot on .destroyed (health<=0). Destroyed poles persist as entities, so the sequence plays and holds its last frame.

Batch 6 delivered 4-frame walk banks for all seven archetypes (guard_default + guard_*_2..4). EntityProjector.applyGuardAppearance selects them through OptionalSpriteFrameCycle and advances only while EntityAnimationStateMachine.hostileState == .moving, so a halted guard holds its still. Under target_frames [6,10] at 4f, same as player.walk.

Batch 6 4-frame boss walk (boss_default_2..4), selected by EntityProjector.applyBossAppearance via OptionalSpriteFrameCycle and gated on hostileState == .moving. New row: the boss walk had no manifest entry before, only boss.telegraph.primary. Under target_frames [6,10] at 4f.
Batch 6 effect layer. 8-frame one-shot spawned at the boss on a BossPhase change, on the ground layer so the boss stands on its own tell. Fires on transition only; holding a phase does not re-fire.

Batch 6 effect layer. 12-frame one-shot spawned by TransientEffectProjector at the extraction entity the first frame it appears, on the overlay layer. Not an entity texture — it needed a spawned node, which is why the frames shipped in #159 and never played.
